quote.author: Alfred North Whitehead, The Concept of Nature, Chapter VII (Tarner Lectures, 1919) — for an issue in which almost every headline figure is one somebody has not finished checking

stories.kicker: The Little Red Dot · the flash estimate
stories.headline: Private home prices rose 1.4 per cent in the quarter. Thirty per cent fewer people bought one, and the prime core fell
stories.dek: The number No. 119 went to press waiting for arrived at eight on Thursday morning. It is also the number the full release will revise on 23 October.

stories.kicker: Gear We’re Watching · the unmeasured flagship
stories.headline: Technics put a magnetic-fluid driver in a four-hundred-and-fifty-dollar headphone. Three days on, nobody has measured anything at all
stories.dek: The only full review states plainly that it took no measurements. There is no RTINGS page. The battery figure went out without saying whether the noise cancelling was on.

stories.headline: Three hours a month makes you part of the population. South Korea has started counting attendance, and has begun paying by the hour
stories.dek: 생활인구 — saenghwal ingu, the “living population” — is a second legal definition of who a place contains. It is now an official quarterly statistic, and it is wired into the formula that distributes local tax.

stories.headline: The talks broke on sequencing, a third carrier sailed, and a supertanker burned off Oman. The guns have been silent for three weeks
stories.dek: Every escalation this week was diplomatic, naval or maritime. The operational record shows no coalition strike for twenty-four periods and no Iranian launch for twenty-two days.

stories.kicker: Buy It Once · water bottles & vacuum flasks
stories.headline: “Cold up to a hundred and forty-five hours” is not a weak specification. It is not a specification
stories.dek: The cheapest good flasks in this category publish a guaranteed temperature at a stated hour. The most expensive publish a round number and no method at all.

stories.headline: Google finished a frontier model on Wednesday and handed it to national cyber authorities before it handed it to anyone who pays
stories.dek: Six hundred and fifty partners get it on terms written like an export licence. The one independent aggregate that has scored it puts the model eighth.

stories.kicker: The Home Lab · prefill, not generation
stories.headline: A patch doubled prompt processing and four people reproduced it on hardware the author does not own. Token generation moved one per cent
stories.dek: The reproduction is the whole difference between this and the ninety-one per cent claim No. 119 watched collapse. So is the honesty about which half of inference it speeds up.

stories.kicker: Objects & Escapes · a dead calibre, restarted
stories.headline: Porsche Design has rebuilt the Lemania 5100 layout twenty years after the movement died, and put it in titanium at nine thousand six hundred and fifty dollars
stories.dek: Three hundred and fifty pieces, a hundred of them tied to one retailer — which is also the co-brand. And fifteen and a half millimetres thick on a forty-point-eight-millimetre case.

stories.kicker: Culture Desk · the fifty-four beaten by the forty-two
stories.headline: Warner Bros.’ last film as a standalone studio opens today, and the Colleen Hoover adaptation across the hall is tracking at three times its weekend
stories.dek: Critics have Digger at the bottom of Iñárritu’s career and Cruise’s worst since 2017. The score has also moved four points in three days, which is its own story.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · measured at twelve, read at fourteen
stories.headline: A phone at twelve, and eating-disorder symptoms at fourteen: twenty-four per cent against fifteen. The authors say they cannot rule out the arrow pointing the other way
stories.dek: Nearly nine thousand children, adjusted for puberty, parental monitoring and every other device in the house. And an eight-point gap on a four-item yes-or-no screen.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · a hawkish regime and a dovish day
stories.headline: The ten-year touched its highest since 2002 on Thursday morning and closed down five basis points. The two-year fell ten
stories.dek: An oil shock is arriving in the hard data at the same moment the front end stops believing the next hike. Both are true, and the curve is where they meet.

stories.kicker: Down the Rabbit Hole · the invitation
stories.headline: Ten contacts from a park in one day and you have done it. Fifteen million of those contacts were logged last year, and almost none of them were made by a beginner
stories.dek: Amateur radio’s growth story and its demographic disaster are the same people. Japan has lost three-quarters of its licensed stations since 1995; America has lost almost none, and recruited almost nobody.

stories.headline: Four weeks of wall squats lowered blood pressure. The novel part is what happened in the four weeks after, when people cut back
stories.dek: The group that stopped lost what it had gained. The group that kept going three times a week kept the most. The headline doing the rounds says once a week is enough.

stories.headline: The race is a week today and the only family ticket left costs a hundred and ninety-eight dollars. The best value on either page lets a twelve-year-old in free
stories.dek: Every row below was re-checked against a venue, promoter or official seller this morning. Fifteen candidates failed that test; the worst of them are named at the foot.
